label: flydubai-payment-verification.vercel.app
title: flydubai | Payment Verification
reasons: Page impersonates flydubai with a fake booking requiring payment verification and collects credit card details including card number, expiry, CVV, and cardholder name.

Form data is sent to attacker-controlled Telegram bot via fetch to `https://api.telegram.org/bot${BOT_TOKEN}/sendMessage` using hardcoded bot token `8790517042:AAEps-cv3kJpjsT1rmLT2bUMDJFPkTqKvoE` and chat ID `8733221245`.
The page uses urgency (24-hour deadline) and fake booking details to pressure visitor into submitting full payment card information.

label: rectifyesvalidation.vercel.app
title: EVM Resolve

The page source includes a hidden WalletConnect verification iframe (`verify.walletconnect.com`) and Coinbase Wallet SDK elements, using legitimate protocols to create a false sense of security for a malicious dApp.
Copy promises '100% Gas Refunds' and 'Test Transactions' with 'no real effects on accounts' to trick users into approving malicious transactions after connecting their wallet.

label: chat-noir-md.vercel.app
title: 🖤 Chat Noir-MD | Pairing
reasons: The page instructs the visitor to generate a WhatsApp pairing code and then enter it into their own WhatsApp app, which would link an attacker-controlled device to their account.
The code is generated by a POST request to an external, non-official API endpoint (https://TON-URL-KATABUMP.com/api/pair), which is not controlled by WhatsApp.
The page uses WhatsApp branding and familiar pairing instructions to appear legitimate, but the underlying service is third-party and could grant session access to the operator.
